events.verdict: Siakam (IND) legally contests Hachimura's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Doncic (LAL) moves forward into Nembhard (IND), who moves through the marginal contact and his SQBR is unaffected.
Turner (IND) cleanly blocks Hachimura's (LAL) dunk attempt and any contact to the body is marginal.
Doncic (LAL) lowers his arm across Haliburton's (IND) non-shooting arm and the marginal contact does not affect his shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) establishes himself in Finney-Smith's (LAL) path and the two players briefly engage.

Doncic (LAL) makes illegal contact to Haliburton's (IND) off-arm after he gathers the ball with his right hand. Since the illegal contact occurs after Haliburton's gather, a shooting foul is correctly called.
Finney-Smith (LAL) remains in bounds when he starts his dribble.
Walker (IND) turns in mid-air, initiating illegal body contact with Finney-Smith (LAL) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in Finney-Smith's (LAL) path and the two players briefly engage and disengage.
James (LAL) collapses his forearm against his own body as he contests and the contact with Mathurin (IND) during the jump shot attempt is marginal.
Nesmith (IND) obtains a legal guarding position in Doncic's (LAL) path during his driving shot attempt.
Doncic (LAL) returns to the floor from his driving shot attempt and the ensuing contact with Nembhard (IND) is marginal and does not dislodge him from his defensive position.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is confirmed that James (LAL) releases his shot attempt before the expiration of the game clock and the basket is successful.
